title: Regional compliance export pipelines: periodic PDF/CSV shipments and residency-aware audit snapshots
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a residency-aware, scheduled export pipeline that produces PDF and CSV compliance packages and dashboard snapshot artifacts for tenants. Each scheduled run should produce per-tenant deliverables (configurable cadence), apply tenant-specific residency and retention filters, encrypt artifacts at rest, and support multiple delivery targets (signed S3 upload, secure SFTP, and PGP-encrypted email). Provide a companion dashboard view that surfaces scheduled runs, success/failure history, and per-tenant retention windows. The feature targets customers using Private/Dedicated modes who require regular certified evidence exports for audits and data residency regulators.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Customers can create scheduled export jobs scoped to a tenant and region with cadence options: daily, weekly, monthly.
2) Exports produce both CSV (tabular records) and a PDF summary report with header, timestamp, and signatures.
3) Residency filters ensure only data that legally resides in the requested region is included; cross-region records are excluded and logged.
4) Artifacts are encrypted using tenant's KMS key (or Redwood-managed key if not provided) at rest and in transit.
5) Delivery options available: S3 (signed PutObject with lifecycle tags), SFTP (with key-based auth), and PGP-encrypted email attachments.
6) Each export run generates a machine-readable manifest (CSV manifest or manifest.txt) and a human-readable certificate PDF stating the dataset, generation time, filters applied, retention TTL, and operator.
7) Dashboard shows last 90 days of runs per-tenant with status, size, delivery destination, and error classification.
8) Retry semantics: 3 retries with exponential backoff; failures create a high-severity incident link and notify tenant admins.
9) Audit logs record who created/modified schedules, delivered artifacts, and KMS key usage.
10) End-to-end tests (integration) that validate residency filtering logic for mixed-region datasets.
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Core export engine and PDF template + CSV exporter (s3 delivery only) + residency filter library. Phase 2: Add SFTP and email channels, KMS integration, and manifest/certificate generation. Phase 3: Dashboard telemetry, retention enforcement hooks, tenant-level scheduling UI, and canary rollout. Key libs: reuse existing KV cache for snapshotting query results to ensure consistency; leverage runtime batch exporter for large result sets; use existing KMS adapter for Private deployments. Must coordinate with Security for key-rotation and with Infra for S3 signed upload quotas. Keep exports idempotent and referenceable by export-run-id. Consider size limits and chunking for >2GB packages.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal alpha for compliance & SE teams with synthetic tenants (2 weeks). 2) Private customers pilot (2-4 customers) using S3-only delivery and manual approval. 3) Open to dedicated customers with auto-scheduling and dashboard (opt-in). 4) Gradual roll to hosted tenants with feature flags. 5) Post-launch: add SFTP/email, PGP option, and retention-driven auto-deletion. Include migration docs for customers using legacy ad-hoc exports.
monitoring_and_alerting: Track export-run.success_rate, export-run.duration, bytes_transferred, and export-run.failure_reasons. Alerting: page on repeated failure (>3 consecutive runs) or on KMS signing failures. Add dashboard panels for per-tenant backlog and pending runs. Emit audit log events to central compliance sink and wire to PagerDuty for P1 failures affecting multiple tenants.
